recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Revisit only if a future publisher or generation change again drops declared common SearchParameter bases from generated expressions.
issue_request: FHIR-17481 was Published/Persuasive and auto-approved for STU3. It asked to fix generated individual-* SearchParameter definitions where Person was listed as a base, using individual-address as the example, because Person.address was missing from expression and XPath fragments were duplicated.
initial_application: Jira records Grahame Grieve's comment 'svn revision 14532'. The corresponding git commit f25a484e20387684e12152c5625b387c453dd71f is titled 'GF#13864 + GF#16001 + GF#17481 - fix errors generating search parameters' and represents the historical application. Checked release3/release4 generated bundles include Person.address and non-duplicated XPath for individual-address and the address variants.
additional_context: The current FHIR source represents common SearchParameters in source/searchparameter/common-search-parameters.xml as code plus base lists rather than full generated expression/xpath fields. source/fhir.ini keeps SearchParameter active in the build, and the common source lists Person as a base for individual-address and the affected address variants. The current CI search-parameters bundle reports individual-address with expression 'Patient.address | Person.address | Practitioner.address | RelatedPerson.address' and no XPath value. The originating Zulip thread matches the Jira report; Confluence searches found no conflicting minutes or decisions.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source edit was made because the authoritative source has the necessary Person base and current generated output has the requested Person.address expression without the old XPath duplication.
